protocol.frozen_external_objective_rule: carrying_changed when no visible carried key/object; visible_door_state_changed when carrying present, shared manually supplied externally to ALL actors, not learned intent or path planning
protocol.proposer: unchanged Wingless DK8.Go/unchanged Yggdrasil R12 and separately-authored conventional C30 each read own selected-public memory; no hidden world state, private map, other actor outcomes or future unselected reward
protocol.native_only: For cap0, if actor abstains, immediately halt that episode BEFORE any env.step; never silently use random policy or collector. A zero-step episode is an honest no-decision result.
protocol.capped: For cap32/64, if an actor abstains and assistance count < cap, execute EXACT original common public C29 collector's selected action, increment external assistance cost; once exhausted, stop BEFORE env.step with explicitly recorded reason. Native proposal never consumes external budget.
protocol.training: Every executed original step gives ONLY own actual selected public after, reward, terminal/truncated to own model; all models trained on exactly same authentic FIT events; do not share online memories or actions after diverging.
protocol.resource: Capture wall/cpu/RSS host only; canonical model checkpoint digest and cold restore per actual episode; run 2 distinct complete original processes and exact evidence hash; retain complete per-action provenance and failure logs.
protocol.actual_task_chain: Track real visible carried key change, real visible door state change and original env goal reward. A goal only counts as native-only if zero external actions in that episode; external successes must never be described as native navigation.
protocol.strongest_control: Conventional C30 independently chooses with exact equal source public FIT/history, same action objective & external caps; report own actions and goal outcome alongside native.

outcomes.success_rule: Only after ALL exact source, crossprocess, cold restore, true selected env.step and conventional controls PASS: each NATIVE model must complete at least one full actual DoorKey task goal with ZERO external actions under cap0. Otherwise NO_NATIVE_ONLY_GOAL regardless of capped effect success or retained controls.
outcomes.no_science: No claim of cognitive generalization, independent natural-language mission parsing, Wingless R8 upgrade, Yggdrasil new architecture, native self-improvement or production autonomy.
